protocol: Three deliveries of the same authorized final records: always a full reply; delta for valid retained state, full otherwise; smallest complete read_changes JSON reply in o200k_base tokens. Cold or explicitly fresh readers require a snapshot. Use the same receipt and head across each comparison. Reconstruct and acknowledge all. Distinct bot principals 00..15: 5 version 1, 6 version 2, 5 unread. Equal weight to every case, repeat the same 16 clients for every case. Compare final delivery and report warm-up separately. Measure compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace (reference tokens, excluding surrounding transport).
template: Line {n}: project {label} assigned team {n % 7} to review the conditions and record the delivery date.

edits.tail: append a version-specific decision line; v3 keeps the v2 line and appends one more
edits.middle: replace the middle line with a version-specific decision
edits.ends: replace first and last lines with version-specific decisions
edits.rewrite: replace every line with different version-specific text

additional_regression: Replay the already opened real Notion acceptance short page and its retained states with the original receipts. Confirm the prior 3241 and 3321 totals before calculating automatic selection. This is a separate diagnostic.
